brief: The classification of the device. For example, `1`, `2`, or `3`. Typically inferred by Relay - SDKs generally do not need to set this directly.
additional_context: The product maps these stringified numeric class codes to `low` (`"1"`), `medium` (`"2"`), and `high` (`"3"`).

changelog.description: Added and deprecated sentry.device.class in favor of device.class
